purpose: User-requested replacement of the original Frost Crown with a simpler ice-and-platinum frame; same stored item and ownership.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: original production alpha artwork for the FitCat collectible avatar frame "Frost Crown".
Input image: edit target; replace this overly busy frame with a more refined minimalist ice crown.
Primary request: elegant premium platinum and translucent ice-blue circular avatar frame, with a clean completely round inner opening centered exactly in the square. A slender sculpted silver ice ring with finely faceted clear-blue crystal inlay, exactly three small understated crown points at the top, tiny restrained frost engraving. Beautiful believable polished platinum and refractive ice, crisp precise edges, delicate luminous cool highlights. Substantially simpler silhouette than the reference.
Composition: square 1024x1024, orthographic front view, symmetric, ring outer diameter about 850 px, inner circular opening diameter about 660 px, centered x512 y512. Top crown tips stay inside a 40 px transparent safe margin. No ornament crossing the inner opening. Keep all artwork inside the square with space around every tip.
Transparency: actual alpha transparency outside the frame AND throughout the empty inner opening. No opaque black, white, grey, checkerboard, scenery, shadow plane, avatar or portrait inside the hole.
Avoid: huge crystal clusters, mist clouds, oversized snowflakes, spiky elaborate filigree, text, monograms, letters, extra objects, watermark. One standalone frame only, no comparison sheet.
normalization: Generated transparent PNG normalized to a 960px square, padded with 32px transparency on every side. Actual alpha aperture measured after WebP encoding; photo fit is independent of the canvas center.
